caption:
The Dambusters practised over a reservoir that still supplies four cities 💧
Before the raid of 16 to 17 May 1943, pilots from 617 Squadron practised low flying over Derwent Reservoir in the Peak District. The Derwent Valley reservoirs supply Sheffield, Nottingham, Derby and Leicester. Howden and Derwent dams were built between 1901 and 1916; Ladybower, the third, flooded the villages of Derwent and Ashopton. Together they hold nearly 46 billion litres.
